Only fields required are firstName/lastName/email/postalCode, all already set; phone is optional.

name: Devon's Top Attractions — Win A Devon Holiday, Free Days Out & other Prizes 2026
notes: Official Devon's Top Attractions (devonstopattractions.co.uk) competition, run by the Association of Devon Attractions — a genuine regional tourism consortium of real Devon attractions (Bovey Castle, Buckfast Abbey, Crealy, etc), same kind of organisation as the already-tracked north-norfolk-attractions. No purchase necessary. Prize: one of nine Devon prizes (camping trip, lodge break, castle stay, spa day, tram driving lesson, theme park passes, coastal cruise, etc). Closes 31 Aug 2026. Gravity Forms with invisible reCAPTCHA v3 (not solved/evaded, just submitted normally) — only name/email required, county/phone optional. Note: this session's own sandbox couldn't complete a live Playwright render of this domain (Chromium got net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET even on already-working sites like thesuffolkcoast.co.uk once routed through this environment's mandatory egress proxy) — that's a sandbox networking artifact, not a site-side bot block; curl fetched the real page and its Gravity Forms markup cleanly with no anti-automation JS. Worth double-checking the very first live run actually reaches the form rather than assuming this is fine.

notes: Official c2c (Trenitalia c2c Limited, c2c-online.co.uk) competition — c2c is the train operator running Essex Thameside services (London Fenchurch Street to Southend/Shoeburyness), i.e. directly relevant to this profile's location. name: TUI Monthly Giveaway — August 2026
notes: Official TUI UK Limited (tui.co.uk) monthly prize draw, no purchase necessary. Prize: £500 off a TUI holiday (min spend £500). Recurs every calendar month with a new countdown/draw — modelled as one Competition row per month reusing the tui-monthly-giveaway adapter; register a fresh 'TUI Monthly Giveaway — <Month> <Year>' row (closesAt = end of that month) once this one closes, rather than expecting this row to re-enter itself. Doubles as TUI's own newsletter signup — entering inherently opts into TUI Group marketing emails, stated plainly on the page with no separate optional checkbox to decline (fine here: that's the point of this project's newsletter side, and it's TUI's own first-party marketing, not third-party sharing). WPForms form (id 93) that lazy-loads its real fields 15-20s after the page settles — confirmed directly, 0 form elements present at 8s, 13 present at 15-20s.

name: British Travel Awards — Win a £5,000 Villa Holiday (vote for Solmar Villas)
notes: Solmar Villas (solmarvillas.com) is nominated in 9 British Travel Awards categories; voting for them on the awards' own official site enters a draw for a £5,000 villa holiday, no purchase necessary. The vote URL pre-selects all 9 categories via its ?nominee= query param — a genuine mechanical company selection, not a fabricated opinion. Three-page Gravity Forms wizard (category review → Confirm Vote → Name/Email/Phone, phone required 'to verify your vote'). That phrasing is a deliberate flag: if it turns out to mean an SMS/call one-time-code step, the adapter fails loudly rather than attempting it (same rule as CAPTCHAs) — confirmed the form's fields exist via curl'd HTML, but not that the post-submit flow is fully automatable end-to-end, so the first live run needs a human's eyes on the resulting screenshot either way. Closes 1 Sept 2026 (tight — one day after this was added).

notes: Official Society of London Theatre (SOLT) prize draw on officiallondontheatre.com — same org already tracked for its newsletter but a genuinely separate form/URL. No purchase necessary; runs 1-8 Sept 2026 per its own T&Cs, one pair of tickets per tour venue. Real server-rendered static form (verified via curl, field names cross-checked against the page's own JSON webform-state schema) — venue radio group (Chelmsford Theatre picked, nearest tour date to this Essex-based profile), first/last name, email, optional postcode, two optional third-party marketing checkboxes left unticked, required 18+/T&Cs checkbox ticked. Submits via client-side fetch() to admin-ajax.php; adapter reads that JSON response's success flag directly. Domain runs Cloudflare bot-management (non-blocking in every observation, adapter fails loudly if a challenge page appears instead). This session's sandboxed Playwright hit a connection-reset routing through this environment's own egress proxy (documented sandbox artifact, not a site block — curl fetched the real form cleanly) — worth confirming the first live run reaches the form.
